intro: The spacious 270m² event space makes it possible to host a wide range of events. In addition to the airy function hall, there is also a gallery available for use. The separate sauna and shower area is large and atmospheric. Next to the sauna there is a changing area with lockers for storing belongings. Pii-Klubi fits 200 people standing, and seated table arrangements can accommodate up to 120 people. The function hall and gallery also have sofas for more relaxed lounging.
noLicense: The venue does not have an alcohol license. Cleaning of the venue is not included in the rental price.
